summary: Phase 1 comprehensive testing of Sogrape Balanced Scorecard Builder. Backend: 16/16 pytest cases passed (health, project CRUD + duplicate, department CRUD + unassign-cascade, objective/measure cascade delete, target CRUD, bulk-import add/update/replace with name resolution + parent linking, update-actuals update-and-create). Frontend: Entry screen wine glasses navigate to portal, portal renders scorecard cards, setup wizard 4-step flow works (validation on empty company name, duplicate-department rejected, submit creates project via API), scorecard sidebar + top-bar + all 4 perspective cards + all 3 view tabs work, Objective + Measure CRUD dialogs work end-to-end via API, live target editor computes achievement (50%/85%/95%) with badges and updates header + sidebar overall (6.3%) in real time, weight validation surface ('Objectives sum to 50.0%') visible, theme toggle switches light<->dark and sidebar remains legible, bulk-import dialog + template download button visible.

minor.issue: Contains a no-op `PROJECTS.update_one({'id': pid}, {'$set': {}})` before the unassign loop that raises `WriteError: '$set' is empty` on some mongo versions. Currently works but is dead code — remove it (server.py lines 279-282).

Response returns the request payload minus 'id' fields (returns only what was PUT) — not the full stored object. Not a functional bug but inconsistent with add_objective which returns fully-hydrated obj.

issues: Sonner toast (top-right) appears in the same z-index as header buttons and can visually cover 'Objective'/'Bulk import' buttons on narrower viewports; consider offsetting the toaster below the header or reducing toast duration.

CRA dev-server surfaces the well-known benign 'ResizeObserver loop completed with undelivered notifications' warning (from Radix UI/Recharts). It appears as a fullscreen error overlay in the preview env and blocks clicks during testing. Not user-facing in production build, but recommend adding a global window.addEventListener('error', ...) filter or upgrading Radix to suppress it.

action_items: Optional: suppress ResizeObserver dev-overlay noise in frontend (window error filter) so it doesn't block preview interactions.
Consider moving Sonner toaster below the top bar so it doesn't overlap the primary action buttons after 'scorecard created' navigation.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py duplicate_project() copies the same 'id' fields for nested arrays (departments/objectives/measures/targets/initiatives) which means edits to the copy would collide by id if the client caches by (project_id, entity_id). Recommend regenerating nested entity ids in duplicate_project as well.
ScorecardPage.jsx is 446 lines — nearing the 700-line threshold; consider extracting PerspectiveView/DepartmentView/PeriodView into their own modules to keep it lean.

BulkImport add mode has an edge case: when an existing entity is found by name AND mode='add', no error is raised and it is silently skipped for departments/measures/objectives (create counter not incremented). This is arguably correct dedupe behaviour but could confuse users if they intended overwriting — surface 'skipped' count in the stats payload.

server.py bulk-import 'replace' mode clears arrays first and then rebuilds; but if targets are supplied referencing an existing measure name that was ALSO cleared, the target's `measure_id` lookup will fall back to whatever measure is created in the same call — this works correctly here because we rebuild in-order (dept → obj → measure → target), but the ordering is implicit; add a comment.
seed_data_creation: Test project created during UI test was cleaned up via DELETE /api/projects/{id}. Pytest fixtures auto-cleanup their own TEST_* prefixed data.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend fully covered by /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py (pytest, 16 tests, parallel-safe with per-session project fixture). Frontend Phase 1 flows verified end-to-end via Playwright: entry -> portal -> setup wizard -> scorecard -> objective/measure/target CRUD -> live calculations -> theme toggle -> bulk-import dialog. Two benign issues surfaced: (1) CRA dev overlay for ResizeObserver blocks click-through during automated tests — production build unaffected; (2) sonner toast can overlap header buttons post-navigation, needs dismissal or z-index tweak. All data-testids present and correctly targeted. Quick-add target testids include the full period label (e.g. 'quick-add-period-Q1 FY26'), not just 'Q1' — future tests should account for fiscal-year suffix.
